pool.sol: Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y}=3\,dx \Rightarrow \ln|y|=3x+C \Rightarrow y=Ae^{3x} \). \( y(0)=A=2 \), so \( y=2e^{3x} \), and \( y(1)=2e^{3} \).
Separable (trivially): \( dy=2x\,dx \Rightarrow y=x^2+C \). \( y(0)=C=5 \), so \( y=x^2+5 \), and \( y(2)=4+5=9 \).

pool.text: A quantity satisfies \( \dfrac{dy}{dt}=-4y \), \( y(0)=10 \). Find the time \( t \) at which \( y=5 \) (the half-life).
pool.sol: Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y}=-4\,dt \Rightarrow \ln y=-4t+C \Rightarrow y=10e^{-4t} \). Setting \( 10e^{-4t}=5 \) gives \( e^{-4t}=\tfrac12 \), so \( -4t=-\ln2 \) and \( t=\dfrac{\ln2}{4} \).
Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y}=x\,dx \Rightarrow \ln y=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+C \Rightarrow y=Ae^{x^2/2} \). \( y(0)=A=3 \), so \( y=3e^{x^2/2} \), and \( y(2)=3e^{4/2}=3e^{2} \).

pool.text: Solve \( \dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{x}{y} \) with \( y(0)=4 \) and \( y>0 \). Find \( y(3) \).
pool.sol: Separable: \( y\,dy=x\,dx \Rightarrow \dfrac{y^2}{2}=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+C \Rightarrow y^2=x^2+C' \). \( y(0)^2=16=C' \), so \( y^2=x^2+16 \), and \( y(3)=\sqrt{9+16}=\sqrt{25}=5 \).

Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y^2}=x\,dx \Rightarrow -\dfrac{1}{y}=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+C \). At \( x=1,y=-1 \): \( 1=\tfrac12+C \Rightarrow C=\tfrac12 \). So \( -\dfrac1y=\dfrac{x^2+1}{2} \Rightarrow y=-\dfrac{2}{x^2+1} \), and \( y(2)=-\dfrac{2}{5} \).

Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{1+y^2}=x\,dx \Rightarrow \arctan y=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+C \). \( y(0)=1 \) gives \( \arctan1=\tfrac{\pi}{4}=C \). So \( \arctan y=\dfrac{x^2}{2}+\dfrac{\pi}{4} \), and \( y(1)=\tan\!\big(\tfrac12+\tfrac{\pi}{4}\big) \).
Separable: \( \dfrac{dy}{y}=\cos x\,dx \Rightarrow \ln y=\sin x+C \Rightarrow y=Ae^{\sin x} \). \( y(0)=A=2 \), so \( y=2e^{\sin x} \), and \( y(\pi/2)=2e^{\sin(\pi/2)}=2e^{1}=2e \).

pool.text: Newton's law of cooling gives \( \dfrac{dT}{dt}=-k(T-20) \). If \( T(0)=100 \) and \( T(5)=60 \), find \( T(10) \).
